title: Plausible Analytics
description: Simple, open-source, lightweight (< 1KB), and privacy-friendly web analytics alternative to Google Analytics with zero cookies and 100% GDPR compliance.
features: Ultra-lightweight script snippet weighing under 1KB (45x lighter than GA4)
No cookie banners required; strictly respects GDPR, CCPA, and PECR privacy rules
Clean, intuitive one-page dashboard displaying all vital metrics at a glance
Custom event tracking, conversion goals, and revenue attribution metrics
Fully open source and self-hostable via Docker Compose with ClickHouse backend
pros: Eliminates annoying cookie consent banners on your website
No impact on site performance and Google Core Web Vitals score
Accurate referral and UTM source tracking
cons: No free hosted cloud tier (30-day trial only, paid cloud plans)
Does not provide cross-device behavioral retargeting or user session stitching
targetAudience: Privacy-focused site owners, SaaS startups, and European businesses needing GDPR compliance.
